ValidationRule.description: Approved Buyout Amount Calculation must be done before accepting the loan on OBL stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !ISPICKVAL(Case__r.cc_Control_Type__c, 'STP'), ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Business_Nature_Type__c, 'Buyout Loan/Finance'), ISCHANGED(cx_ln_Document_Verifier_OBL_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cx_ln_Document_Verifier_OBL_Result__c, 'Accept'), OR( ISNULL(cx_ln_Approved_Buyout_Amount__c), cx_ln_Approved_Buyout_Amount__c = 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved Buyout Amount Calculation must be Completed ,please check the Liabilities Details tab
